concept.title: Formatting Date Fields For Non-Localized Template

conbody.p: A non-localized template is one where the locale settings are not defined while creating the template (i.e., the Enable Formatting option was not selected when the template was created and hence the locale settings are not formatted). For more information on creating a new template, see Creating New Templates. Using this feature, now we can apply different date formats to fields even for non-localized templates.
